versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Binary Manifest of the Software Clus- ter Connection shall map the immutable columns of all tables to a constant, 32 bit aligned memory section named CONST_IMMUTABLE_COLUMNS . The immutable columns are: • all columns of the Interface Descriptor Table • Offered Interface Handle Column • Subscribed Interface Default Handle Column
